title: Vector and Archive Anew
author: Astrid Thackeray
blurb: Casper Voss, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
